prompt: A flowering drug-type Cannabis plant in recirculating culture shows reduced growth and stress symptoms while root-zone salts are elevated. How should Grow Doc distinguish a salinity-stress hypothesis from a specific nutrient-deficiency claim?
expected_points: Controlled drug-type Cannabis research has shown measurable physiological and growth responses to increasing NaCl in hydroponic and aquaponic solutions, supporting salinity as a plausible stressor when root-zone salt exposure is documented.

A salinity-stress response does not by itself identify one specific nutrient deficiency or toxicity because ionic strength, nutrient interactions, medium chemistry, and cultivar response can overlap in visible symptoms.

Grow Doc should require structured EC/salinity and root-zone context, then use plant or solution measurements to refine the differential instead of inferring a specific nutrient cause from appearance alone.
forbidden_claims: Visible chlorosis alone proves NaCl toxicity
Any high-EC Cannabis plant has one specific nutrient deficiency

source_metadata.title: Aquaponic and Hydroponic Solutions Modulate NaCl-Induced Stress in Drug-Type Cannabis sativa L.

prompt: What can Grow Doc safely infer from a controlled industrial-hemp water-deficit experiment, and what should it avoid generalizing to every Cannabis cultivar and grow system?
expected_points: A controlled greenhouse study of the industrial-hemp cultivar Black Label found that water deficit reduced biomass and total seed yield while inducing physiological water-stress responses.
The reported responses came from one cultivar under defined moderate and extreme water-deficit treatments, so their magnitude and thresholds are study-specific.
Grow Doc should use those findings as evidence that Cannabis can respond strongly to water deficit, not as universal loss percentages, irrigation thresholds, or cultivar-independent predictions.
forbidden_claims: All Cannabis cultivars respond identically to the same water deficit
The study defines a universal irrigation threshold for all grow systems

source_metadata.title: Physiological and morphological responses of industrial hemp (Cannabis sativa L.) to water deficit
